policy.purpose: Current-runtime descriptive SCC comparison; AKM baseline, four-core primary panel, one-way worker clustering

submission_note: Initial submission command failed before launching any job because SCC login Python 3.6 lacks subprocess text=; corrected to universal_newlines=True.
capture_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of sorted-key compact JSON serialization of the capture object, using Python json defaults
limitations: Descriptive Linux campaign; not quiet-Mac release qualification.

All corresponding configurations used different hosts between campaigns; paired ratios compare fereg and fixest on the same node within each campaign but do not isolate optimization effects from hardware.
Three repetitions do not establish narrow confidence bounds for small timing gaps.
Phase clocks may nest and must not be summed.
Reference oracle/comparison failures remain ineligible; no tolerances or conventions were weakened.
